title: Mini Petite Lit Up Glassy Gel Highlighter Stick
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Radiant Finish✓ High Shine Finish✓ Plumping

What it is: A clean, multitasking gel highlighter that delivers a facial-fresh, glow to instantly perk up dull skin. Translucent, glassy sheen.


Coverage: Light


Finish: Radiant


Formulation: Stick


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Vitus Vita Fruit Extract: Visibly firms and boosts moisture.

- Emollient oil blend: Helps with smooth application + softens skin

- Special Effect Pigments: Boosts radiance.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.


How to Use+



Suggested Usage:

Can be worn alone, under or over foundation.


For Dimension: Dab on high points of face, cupid’s bow and center of bottom lip

To Mask Fatigue: Use under concealer or close to tear ducts

To Accentuate & Life: Apply to top of cheekbones up to temples

For Juicy Hydration: Apply as a lip balm


Gucci Westman’s Tip: Glide on tops of Cheeks, cheekbones, cupid's bow and lips for radiant clarity.  

Ingredients+

-Vitus Vita Grape Extract: Visibly firms, boosts moisture, and helps to detoxify.

-Special Effect Pigment: Boosts glassy radiance.

-Emollient Oil Blend: Helps with smooth application and softens skin.


Parla:

Diisostearyl Malate, Octyldodecanol, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Synthetic Wax, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Synthetic Beeswax, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Fruit Extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dicalcium Phosphate, Silica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tin Oxide, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Mica, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, 77492, 77499), Red 7 (CI 15850). 


Petal:

Diisostearyl Malate, Octyldodecanol, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Synthetic Wax, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Mica, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Synthetic Beeswax, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Fruit Extract, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Silica, Tin Oxide, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, 77492), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090).


Lit:

Dicalcium Phosphate Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Tin Oxide, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl ,, Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Fruit Extract [Vitis Vinifera Fruit Extract], Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).
